verdict.rationale: Tool-access control is a fair question for a coding agent, so the axis applies. The pack documents user-invoked tools such as /web, /run and /test, plus general configuration via command-line switches, .aider.conf.yml and AIDER_xxx environment variables. Nothing shows a documented way to allow or deny which external tools or integrations the agent may use; generic config options are an adjacent control and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control which external tools and integrations the agent is allowed to access
